Each seat needs a living face. At join the applicant sits a 12 minute call where a proctor shows three words, cipher, dawn and comet, works them into a spoken sentence, then asks him to turn his head and read a 9 digit number. The client hashes that face into a registry refusing a match against an existing key, so one face holds one seat, checked every 90 days.

Brokers sell humans at $4, so 50 seats run $200 plus 50 people kept reachable, each free to reclaim the key and leave with the balance. A comet borrows its tail; a borrowed face gives itself back.
